description: This file defines the 'Html' class which extends 'BaseWriter' in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It primarily handles the conversion of a Spreadsheet object into an HTML representation, including generating full HTML documents, styles, sheet data, images, charts, and handling cell merging (spans). It provides methods for customizing the output, such as setting images roots, inline CSS usage, and callbacks for editing the HTML before finalization.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: Defines the Html class for rendering Spreadsheet objects into HTML format, including styles, images, charts, and handling of merged cells and sheet navigation. It provides configuration such as inline CSS, image embedding, and callback editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Spreadsheet as an HTML file or stream to the specified filename.

methods.name: generateHtmlAll
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML representation of the spreadsheet, including header, navigation, sheet data, and footer.

methods.name: setEditHtmlCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for editing or modifying the generated HTML before output.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the current sheet index targeted for output.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the sheet index to specify which sheet to output.

methods.name: getGenerateSheetNavigationBlock
methods.description: Returns whether the navigation block for sheet tabs is generated.

methods.name: setGenerateSheetNavigationBlock
methods.description: Enables or disables the generation of the sheet navigation block.

methods.name: writeAllSheets
methods.description: Resets the sheet index to include all sheets in the output.

methods.name: generateHTMLHeader
methods.description: Creates the HTML header section including metadata and styles.

methods.name: generateStyles
methods.description: Builds and outputs the CSS styles used in the HTML document.

methods.name: generateHTMLFooter
methods.description: Returns the closing tags for the HTML document.

methods.name: getImagesRoot
methods.description: Returns the root path or URL for images.

methods.name: setImagesRoot
methods.description: Sets the root path or URL for images.

methods.name: getEmbedImages
methods.description: Returns whether images are embedded as data URIs.

methods.name: getUseInlineCss
methods.description: Returns whether inline CSS is used.

methods.name: setUseInlineCss
methods.description: Enables or disables inline CSS usage.

methods.name: formatColor
methods.description: Wraps cell values in a span with inline color style if the cell has a color format.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the page orientation if applicable, typically for PDF output.
